label: Bible Study
prompt: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and _____ spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verse: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
note: Real beauty is inner — a meek and quiet spirit is precious to God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the _____ that is in Christ Jesus.
verse: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
note: Paul's charge to Timothy: be strong — not in your own grit, but in the grace that is in Christ.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child _____ seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verse: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
note: The Shunammite's son came back to life with seven sneezes — the only time 'sneezed' appears in the KJV.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can _____ nothing out.
verse: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
note: An echo of Job's 'naked came I out': we arrive empty-handed and leave the same way — so hold things loosely.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and _____ the girdle of his reins.
verse: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
note: The coming Branch of Jesse wears righteousness and 'faithfulness' as his belt — character worn as clothing.
